Senior Business Process Automation Engineer at a manufacturing company with 10,001+ employees
The standard feature of UiPath Platform is UiPath Studio, which also includes a terminal and multiple cloud code extensions. This enhances the workflow, rendering a lot of work that used to take days into minutes or hours. Previously, I used to code manually integrated templates, naming each activity and running all the code with multiple unit tests and debugging each flow. This took a significant amount of time. Now, since there are code extensions available, I can give a detailed prompt and get a workflow done quickly. The testing also occurs at a much faster pace, and if there are multiple validation errors, the RMID packages are already generated. The modern activities have higher user engagement compared to classic activities, which had fewer features. The integration services are also effective, but utilizing the integrations and achieving scalability is straightforward since it operates on XAML, allowing me to create multiple XAMLs to enhance scalability. We mainly use UiPath Platform because it is low code compared to traditional approaches when AI was not involved. UiPath Platform makes it easy to learn, create RPA workflows, push to production, and obtain code reviews since it is virtually a low-code platform. This year, we have improved our project delivery speed significantly, moving into a product with much less time than traditional programming languages.

Sathyajith S
Technical Specialist - Platform Engineer at a financial services firm with 10,001+ employees
Some of the best features I can highlight in the UiPath Platform include its low-code development capabilities, which make it easy for developers to build and deploy automations. The drag-and-drop workflow design significantly reduces development effort and accelerates delivery, making it one of the platform's most valuable features. Another key capability is AI-powered Document Understanding, which extracts data from invoices, forms, emails, and other documents, significantly reducing manual data entry. Document Understanding is one of the most valuable features for automating document-intensive business processes and is widely used across my organization. UiPath Apps enable business users to quickly build business-facing applications on top of automation workflows, providing a user-friendly interface for interacting with automations. The feedback we have received indicates that these applications effectively bridge the gap between business users and backend automations, making automation solutions more accessible and user-friendly. UiPath Orchestrator provides centralized management of robots, queues, assets, schedules, and monitoring, ensuring strong governance and operational control. It offers excellent visibility into automation performance and provides a single platform for managing automation operations across the organization. The platform's integration capabilities work well with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, web applications, and legacy systems. This broad integration ecosystem helps reduce implementation complexity and enables seamless connectivity across business applications. AI Center allows organizations to deploy, manage, and integrate AI models into automation workflows, extending automation capabilities beyond rule-based processes. Additionally, Process Mining and Task Mining help identify automation opportunities by analysing real process data and user activities. These capabilities assist organizations in prioritizing automation initiatives based on measurable business value and operational insights. Considering all these features, including low-code development, Document Understanding, UiPath Apps, Orchestrator, integrations, AI Center, and Process Mining, I believe Document Understanding has had the greatest impact on my team. It is used across multiple business regions to automate the extraction of information from invoices, claims, forms, emails, and PDF documents. This capability eliminates a significant amount of manual data entry effort and delivers immediate value to operations teams, especially when combined with AI models and human validation workflows. Its ability to handle both structured and semi-structured documents makes it one of the most widely adopted and impactful features used by business users across my organization.

Valuable Features
UiPath Platform's most valued features include its user-friendly low-code interface and drag-and-drop capabilities, facilitating rapid automation development accessible to non-developers. Seamless integration with diverse applications enhances document processing and data extraction. Key tools like Orchestrator, StudioX, and AI components reduce human error and operational costs. Users appreciate robust automation for Excel, PDFs, and email, supported by extensive training and community resources. The platform's flexibility, scalability, and continuous learning support enable significant time and cost savings across industries.
"UiPath Platform has positively impacted my organization by reducing cycle time, decreasing costs spent on particular use cases, improving system availability, accuracy, execution speed, and meeting SLAs."
"UiPath Platform has positively impacted our organization by providing major productivity improvements through automating day-to-day tasks."
"UiPath Platform has positively impacted my organization because it stands out as the go-to RPA for all types of automation compared to other platforms like Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism, and SAP BPA."
Room for Improvement
Users suggest that UiPath Platform needs improvements in licensing and cost management, especially for small businesses. The learning curve remains steep for some users, necessitating improved onboarding and more tutorials. Security enhancements, particularly in integrations, are desired. Users find some version updates and documentation lacking, complicating the upgrade process. The AI and OCR features require better accuracy and integration. Increased support for seamless cross-platform and third-party integrations would enhance functionality.
"The initial charge on the platform is built into the unified platform price which is a bit expensive, but if that can be eliminated, the pricing is good compared to competitors."
"I believe UiPath Platform can improve its licensing costs, which are currently higher than competitors."
"The pricing, setup costs, and licensing for UiPath Platform are quite high, making it challenging for many organizations to afford."
ROI
UiPath Platform users have reported significant improvements in processing times and data accuracy, leading to notable cost savings and increased efficiency. Automation has allowed many organizations to save thousands of hours annually, freeing up employees to focus on more strategic tasks. Some companies experienced returns as high as 16 times, with automation maintaining or increasing accuracy above 90%. In many cases, users have seen returns within one year of implementation due to reduced manual effort.
Pricing
UiPath Platform's pricing is perceived as high, especially as compared to alternatives like Automation Anywhere and Microsoft Power Automate. Enterprises appreciate its robust features and ease of use, but smaller businesses face affordability challenges. The community edition is popular for learning, offering a cost-effective introduction without investment. Setup costs are manageable, but licensing complexities can be a deterrent, leading to pushback and preference for more transparent pricing. Despite higher costs, many find the ROI justifiable due to its efficiency and automation capabilities.
"It is based on the use case. If the use case needs several bots, it gets expensive."
"The price of UiPath Platform in the Middle East region is a little bit high; having a lower price for the Middle East region would make it more attractive."
"I would definitely recommend UiPath, although the major concern is that it's not super cheap. Despite its higher price, I understand the complexity behind it since it's the most comprehensive RPA solution."
Popular Use Cases
UiPath Platform is widely used for process automation across multiple sectors like finance, healthcare, and manufacturing, primarily focusing on tasks like invoice processing and document management. Organizations employ it for automating monotonous operations such as data entry, reconciliation, and generating reports, significantly enhancing operational efficiency by minimizing human errors and accelerating processing times. It facilitates seamless integration with existing systems, allowing businesses to optimize workflows, manage large datasets, and streamline communication between applications, thereby improving productivity and reducing workload.
Service and Support
UiPath Platform's customer service and support are praised for their responsiveness and expertise, offering prompt solutions and strong communication. Many users have rated support highly, with some noting room for improvement in response times and ticket routing. The community forum is often utilized for additional help, highlighting its value and accessibility. Some technical issues require longer resolution times, but overall, users find the support team knowledgeable and dedicated.
Deployment
Users reported that UiPath Platform's initial setup is generally straightforward and quick, often completed in a matter of hours or days. Some noted it as intuitive, aided by clear documentation and support. However, experiences varied based on project complexity and organizational factors. Companies with existing infrastructure or security protocols sometimes found setup more challenging. Overall, involving knowledgeable staff or partners facilitated smoother implementation, and maintenance requirements were generally minimal post-deployment.
Scalability
UiPath Platform offers strong scalability, allowing organizations to expand automation capabilities easily. Companies report that scaling can be done with minimal effort, typically involving additional licenses and virtual infrastructure. It efficiently handles increased workloads without significant performance issues. Its robust framework supports various process automations, making it adaptable for different business needs. Despite some concerns with licensing costs, users find the platform scalable for both small and large deployments.
Stability
UiPath Platform is highly stable, receiving positive feedback from various users for its reliability. While some users report minor issues like occasional crashes or performance hiccups, many commend it for smooth and effective operations. Users appreciate consistent updates and quick resolutions to emerging problems. Some have noted dependencies on external factors, like third-party applications, suggesting that stability can vary depending on integration and deployment environments. Users find it generally robust, with high user satisfaction and minimal downtime reported.
These insights are based on the in-depth reviews provided by peers to help you make a better buying decision.

UiPath Platform delivers a robust set of features that enhance automation and productivity. With components like Orchestrator, task management is optimized, facilitating better scalability. Users benefit from advanced AI and document understanding tools, boosting data handling accuracy and reducing errors. Despite its strengths, UiPath faces challenges with upgrading processes, AI enhancements, and user documentation. Integration and selector sensitivity issues, along with support and licensing complexities, highlight areas for potential improvement. Users request smoother deployment, error handling, and migration processes. Enhanced support for RHEL/Ubuntu, LINQ, and Lambda and improved real-time insights, automation recording, and scheduling are desired. Streamlining the experience for non-technical users with simplified workflows remains a priority.
What are the key features of UiPath Platform?
Drag-and-Drop Functionality: Allows users to design workflows easily without extensive technical skills.
Orchestrator: Enhances task management and enables scalable automation.
AI and Document Understanding: Improves data accuracy and minimizes errors.
System Integration: Offers seamless integration with SAP, CRM, Oracle, and more.
Active Community and Training: UiPath Academy provides resources for skill development.
What benefits should users look for in reviews?
Increased Efficiency: Reduction in manual workloads through automation of repetitive tasks.
Improved Accuracy: Enhanced data handling capabilities reduce errors.
Productivity Boost: Supports both attended and unattended automations to streamline operations.
Scalability: Ability to handle growing automation demands efficiently.
Integration Benefits: Easy integration with enterprise systems for streamlined operations.
UiPath Platform is widely implemented across sectors such as finance, healthcare, insurance, HR, IT, and supply chain to automate repetitive business tasks. Common uses include automating data entry, invoice processing, document management, report generation, and customer service operations. Organizations value the platform's ability to integrate seamlessly with systems like SAP, CRM, and Oracle, allowing for enhanced efficiency and accuracy in processing both structured and unstructured data.
UiPath Platform was previously known as UiPath Maestro, UiPath Apps, UiPath Agent Builder.

What is our primary use case?
My main use cases for
UiPath Platform

We are starting the data or using business logic to create the data in the required format, which is detailed for the business and shared back with them. It also involves entering data into different applications such as Oracle,
Salesforce

Let me take a simple automation, such as an order entry, as an example. We get multiple orders from different customers in PDF format. I need to use
UiPath Platform
and Regex and
Stream
manipulations to extract the required data from PDFs, such as the processing date, invoice number, the number of items purchased, and the unit price of each item. After I extract those items, I create a CSV and then upload it into Oracle by concurrent programs or manually enter it into Oracle. Once the process is done, I need to gather all the data again, update it to a database, and create multiple Excel files to share back with the business to close the end of the process. That is how a simple PDF automation works.
In some of the processes involving PDFs, such as making a discount PDF, the PDF includes an IDR structured format. I study specific sections and use multiple regexes to extract the data needed. Based on the confidence levels, I create the data separately and combine it into a text to send it into a verac. The scanned PDF document takes more time and is more critical than a straightforward native PDF. I also work on UiPath Platform Restore Center on the website, where, if the selector is not available, I need to expect the elements and define selectors or fuzzy selectors to make it work.

What is our primary use case?
My main use case for
UiPath Platform
is automations to develop bots for deterministic tasks.
An example of a deterministic task I automate with
UiPath Platform
is a report that we have to create, which is about developing a dashboard for customer satisfaction. At the end of every support call, a survey is sent to the customer, and when they respond, it comes to a survey platform. We run a report and curate it to different teams at HP. A human was taking about six hours approximately, and I developed a bot on UiPath Platform, which runs the report in mere eight minutes.
Regarding my main use cases with UiPath Platform, I have had a few other use cases, a few related to report generations itself and few sending completion reports. If you have to send a completion report at the end of the week or every week to a manager, we have automated that as well.
We are mainly looking at agentic automations for processes that involve unstructured information, multiple systems, or which require some level of decision making rather than just straightforward rule-based tasks. One example would be document processing or email processing. As an AI agent, an agent can understand the intent of incoming email, it can identify the relevant information from attachments or documents, it can classify the request and determine what action needs to happen next.
